text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Carrying these feelings that couldn't reach before in my heart...
I sprint across the turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —I won't let anyone get in my way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Taking without hesitation, giving without regret—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'll carve it with my hoofprints—
all of my love.
